column3: Microcontroller board, axis controller: Arduino Nano running firmware/axis/SURF_nanoAxis_v5

column3: Closed-loop stepper driver, model designation CL57T; one each for H, V, R
column10: The designation alone does not identify manufacturer and hardware revision. Microstep and current settings are build data, see hardware/assembly.md.

column3: Stepper motor, NEMA 23 frame, 200 full steps per revolution; one per axis
column10: NEMA 23 and 200 steps/rev come only from a superseded README title and a superseded sketch.

column3: Endstop switch, normally closed (NC), wired between input pin and GND; homing reference for H and V
column10: Do NOT fit normally open switches: the firmware treats HIGH as triggered (hardware/pinout.md pitfall 1). No switch exists for R or for the negative ends of H and V.

column3: Screw with 4 mm lead, linear drive for H and V (200 steps/rev x 16 microsteps / 4 mm = 800 steps/mm)
column10: The 4 mm lead is recorded only in a superseded sketch.

column3: Linear slide/guide, horizontal (H) and vertical (V)
column10: Minimum free travel implied by the firmware is derived in hardware/assembly.md.

column3: Bevel gearbox, nominal ratio 1:2 (two motor revolutions per output revolution), rotation stage R
column10: The calibrated 16.156 / 16.1599 steps/deg is about 9% below the nominal 17.78 steps/deg implied by 1:2 x 3200 steps/rev; the actual ratio is not recorded (hardware/assembly.md).
